regime_context: The detector shows a broad-but-not-crowded leadership cluster in semiconductors (Memory/HBM & Storage, AI Infrastructure, AI Semiconductors, Semiconductor Equipment) with the Memory theme as clear leader and no confirmed handoff. The one validated edge is the absolute-trend gate (gate_helps=true), so leans should favour eligible, broad, trending themes but stay humble on directionality given dir_accuracy is only 0.526.
emerging_watch: Watching whether AI Infrastructure (rank 2, score 1.745, margin 0.595 below the leader) narrows the gap to Memory/HBM & Storage and completes a confirmed leadership handoff — the condition that would retire this watch is AI Infrastructure overtaking Memory in rank with a positive margin while both remain eligible.

theses.subject: Memory, HBM & Storage
theses.thesis: The clear momentum leader (score 2.34, margin 0.595 over second place) with rising breadth (0.75), a healthy durability bar (0.68), and no crowding (crowding_z 0.53). Momentum rank is a focus lens, not alpha, but within an eligible, trend-gated universe the staying-power logic favours maintaining exposure here while it holds the trend gate.
evidence: rank 1, score 2.34, leader with 0.595 margin over challenger
theses.dissent: Memory/HBM is a notoriously cyclical, boom-bust segment; the rank leadership could simply reflect a late-cycle pricing spike, and 'mixed' hurst_tag means the trend is not cleanly persistent.

falsifier.text: SMH underperforms the S&P 500 by 5% or more over the next 30 trading days

theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Strongest trend-health in the eligible set (durability_bar 0.76, hurst_tag 'trend', breadth 0.9) and rank 3. The crowding flag (crowding_z 1.82, crowded=true) is a size-down caution only, not a fade — the absolute-trend gate remains the discipline. Lean favours the intact trend but with reduced sizing appetite.
theses.dissent: High crowding_z of 1.82 means positioning is extended; if this is a late-stage trend, drawdown risk is elevated and the trend gate could trip quickly.

falsifier.text: CIBR breaks below its trailing 30-day trend gate (eligible flips false) before the check-by date

theses.subject: Silver Miners
theses.thesis: Rank 4 with a positive score (1.182), eligible, low crowding (0.21), and moderate breadth (0.625). Not the leader, but a non-crowded, trend-gated theme that offers differentiation away from the concentrated semiconductor cluster. Conviction kept low because durability is middling (0.56) and hurst is mixed.
theses.dissent: Mixed hurst and only 0.625 breadth suggest the move may be narrow and fragile; precious-metal miners are highly sensitive to real rates and a single macro surprise could reverse it.

falsifier.text: SIL lags GDX by 4% or more over the next 20 trading days
